base:
Product.update(ProductRequest request) normalizes category with request.category().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).
ProductRequest: @NotBlank String category; @Size(max=2000) String description. Description is optional. Product.update maps null description to an empty string.
PostgreSQL migration: category VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL. The API GET /api/products/categories promises all normalized categories, distinct and sorted, with no product paging. Hibernate/PostgreSQL is the supported persistence stack.
